def row_views(payload: MatchPayload, version: VersionRecord) -> list[MatchRowView]:
    store = VersionSourceStore(version,payload.jd_text)
    validate_bundle(store,payload.bundle)
    results = {r.atom_id:r for r in payload.bundle.mapping.atom_results}
    parents = {p.requirement_id:p for p in payload.bundle.requirements.parents}
    rows = []
    for atom in payload.bundle.requirements.atoms:
        result = results[atom.atom_id]
        links = []
        for link in result.links:
            path, fact = store.origins[link.source_span.source_id]
            span = link.source_span
            original_span = fact.source.model_copy(update={'start':fact.source.start+span.start_offset,'end':fact.source.start+span.end_offset})
            links.append(MatchLinkView(path=path,quote=span.exact_quote,

@staticmethod
    def _validate_payload(row,payload,version):
        raw = row['request_json']
        if digest(row['resume_id']+raw)!=row['request_hash']:
            raise InvalidProvenance('match_integrity_failed')
        request = json.loads(raw)
        if (payload.match_id!=row['match_id'] or payload.resume_id!=row['resume_id'] or payload.version_id!=version.version_id
            or payload.version_hash!=version.content_hash or payload.jd_text!=request['jd_text']
            or payload.title!=request['title'] or payload.mode!=request['mode']
            or payload.bundle.manifest.run_id!=row['match_id']):
            raise InvalidProvenance('match_integrity_failed')
        row_views(payload,version)  # Hash/quote/C1/JD exclusion validated on write and read.
        expected = propose_order(version,VersionSourceStore(version,payload.jd_text),payload.bundle)
        if payload.proposals != expected:
            raise InvalidProvenance('match_proposals_changed')

        row,payload,version = self._load(db,owner,match_id)
        head = self.workspace._resume(db,owner,row['resume_id'])['head_version_id']
        decisions = {r['proposal_id']:r for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_match_decisions WHERE match_id=?',(match_id,))}
        proposals = [ProposalView(**p.model_dump(),decision=decisions[p.proposal_id]['decision'] if p.proposal_id in decisions else 'pending',
                                 accepted_version_id=decisions[p.proposal_id]['accepted_version_id'] if p.proposal_id in decisions else None)
                     for p in payload.proposals]
        return MatchView(match_id=match_id,resume_id=row['resume_id'],version_id=version.version_id,version_hash=version.content_hash,
                         title=payload.title,jd_text=payload.jd_text,mode=payload.mode,provider=payload.bundle.manifest.provider,model=payload.bundle.manifest.model,
                         usage=payload.usage,created_at=payload.created_at,expected_head_version_id=row['expected_head'],can_apply=head==row['expected_head'],

    def get(self, owner, match_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            return self._view(db,owner,match_id)

    def list(self, owner, resume_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            self.workspace._resume(db,owner,resume_id)
            rows = db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_matches WHERE owner_id=? AND resume_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC,match_id DESC LIMIT 100',(owner,resume_id)).fetchall()
            return [MatchSummary(**{k:r[k] for k in MatchSummary.model_fields}) for r in rows]

    def decide(self, owner, match_id, proposal_id, request: DecideProposal):
        with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
            row,payload,_ = self._load(db,owner,match_id)
            proposal = next((p for p in payload.proposals if p.proposal_id==proposal_id),None)
            if proposal is None:raise WorkspaceNotFound('proposal_not_found')
            previous = db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_match_decisions WHERE match_id=? AND proposal_id=?',(match_id,proposal_id)).fetchone()
            decision = 'accepted' if request.action=='accept' else 'rejected'
            if previous:
                if previous['decision']!=decision:raise WorkspaceConflict('proposal_already_decided')
                version = self.workspace._version(db,row['resume_id'],previous['accepted_version_id']) if previous['accepted_version_id'] else None
                return DecisionResult(match=self._view(db,owner,match_id),version=version)
            version = None
            if request.action=='accept':
                resume = self.workspace._resume(db,owner,row['resume_id'])
                if resume['head_version_id']!=row['expected_head'] or request.expected_parent_version_id!=row['expected_head']:
                    raise WorkspaceConflict('resume_head_changed')
                current = self.workspace._version(db,row['resume_id'],row['expected_head'])
                document = current.document.model_copy(deep=True)
                entries = getattr(document,proposal.section)
                index = next((i for i,e in enumerate(entries) if (e.fact_id if proposal.section=='skills' else e.entry_id)==proposal.target_id),None)
                if index is None or index==0:raise WorkspaceConflict('proposal_no_longer_applicable')
                entries.insert(0,entries.pop(index))
                document = ResumeDocument.model_validate(document.model_dump())
                # Reordering can never mutate/add/remove the actual fact inventory.
                before = sorted(f.model_dump_json() for f in current.document.facts())
                after = sorted(f.model_dump_json() for f in document.facts())
                if before!=after:raise MatchError('proposal_changed_facts')
                version = self.workspace._append(db,owner,row['resume_id'],document,sequence=current.sequence+1,
                                                 parent=current.version_id,note='按 JD 相关线索调整既有条目顺序（无新增事实）')
                db.execute('UPDATE rw_matches SET expected_head=? WHERE match_id=?',(version.version_id,match_id))
            db.execute('INSERT INTO rw_match_decisions VALUES (?,?,?,?)',(match_id,proposal_id,decision,version.version_id if version else None))
            return DecisionResult(match=self._view(db,owner,match_id),version=version)

### 真实HTTP暴露的事务补充（实施中）

373项相关回归通过后，带独立索引worker的真实HTTP首次在面试读取时发生SQLite database locked，失败日志保留为s3-http-model-v2-failed.log。外层状态读事务持有SHARED锁，后台worker提交进入PENDING，引用校验再开连接请求新的SHARED，形成等待环。修复要求：InterviewRepository._load内所有私有/公开引用校验复用调用方当前数据库事务；CodeRAG读取和公开知识校验提供仅内部使用的可选db参数，默认独立调用兼容原行为。不能仅延长超时、关闭worker或跳过引用完整性检查。增加真实并发提交回归，确认状态读结束后写事务确实提交，而非仅没有抛异常。

新增字段有默认值兼容旧SQLite checkpoint；不改旧来源/C1/审批，不迁移个人数据。回滚需依本轮diff恢复旧引擎接线，尚无单独运行时开关；保留已产生trace/pack。收尾同步CURRENT_SPEC/CHANGELOG/EXPAND-S3/架构图和必要决策；交付一张状态图、3—5源码入口、一个不足反例、5面试追问和20—40分钟导读。

### 实施前预算补充

- 父计划deadline传入ToolContext；既有ToolExecutor需取`min(父deadline, 当前+工具timeout)`，不能重设延长父时限。只保证调用前/后拒绝晚结果，不宣称硬中止GPU。新增父deadline单测并复跑原运行时合同。

- 缺命中只说明retrieval_empty/answerability_unknown；仅范围确实没有资料才no_material_in_scope。请求个人贡献或量化运行结果，源码/测试文件不足以证明，返回needs_input；语义支持待人工/后续Reviewer，不靠命中数自动通过。
- 结束后review现有资源循环会直调knowledge最多6次，未进入会话tool_trace。改为完成/owner gate之后独立有ID的资源检索pack（最多2检索/2工具/同模型预算），显式标为post_review执行，不假装已计入场内18次；活动场内仍≤18。保留learning_resources外形，增加资源pack/usage摘要，避免无计数的嵌套资源循环。

### 实施前预算补充

- 工具结果在32K序列化上限之前做确定性投影：引用整段预算8000字符，公开entry不重复携带body（正文仍在reference.quote），省略整段留下位置和原因；保留候选trace。太大的代码段可用计数内的read_code_range读取有限完整行，不自行拼造引用。Public全条目引用不可随意截短。
- 父计划deadline传入ToolContext；既有ToolExecutor需取`min(父deadline, 当前+工具timeout)`，不能重设延长父时限。只保证调用前/后拒绝晚结果，不宣称硬中止GPU。新增父deadline单测并复跑原运行时合同。
- 每次搜索预留真实已配置后端的模型调用/输入上界：Embedding query≤1024 token，重排≤30×512 pair token；最多2搜索轮，总上界≤32768。记录reserved upper bound，不能冒称实测token用量。读取不预留模型预算，所有搜索/读取仍走原18次计数。
- 缺命中只说明retrieval_empty/answerability_unknown；仅范围确实没有资料才no_material_in_scope。请求个人贡献或量化运行结果，源码/测试文件不足以证明，返回needs_input；语义支持待人工/后续Reviewer，不靠命中数自动通过。
- 结束后review现有资源循环会直调knowledge最多6次，未进入会话tool_trace。改为完成/owner gate之后独立有ID的资源检索pack（最多2检索/2工具/同模型预算），显式标为post_review执行，不假装已计入场内18次；活动场内仍≤18。保留learning_resources外形，增加资源pack/usage摘要，避免无计数的嵌套资源循环。

## 数据与状态合同

新增resume_workspace/evidence_pack.py：

- RetrievalScope来自服务端owner/project/snapshot或public（question/doc），不能由模型filter指定。
- RetrievalPlan包含query、kind（exact_symbol/semantic/cross_file/runtime_evidence）、scope、可用工具、第一次/修正query、最多2检索轮/5工具/输入模型预算上界/quote预算/调用前deadline。改写采用固定补充词（调用/定义/测试或runtime报告），不是伪造新的事实。
- PackItem包括原始EvidenceReference、可选符号/公开entry、location_valid、relevance=candidate；引用逐个重查owner/hash/quote/range，错误引用硬拒绝，不以补检索掩盖完整性损坏。内容相关、断言支持分别保持待判。
- ClaimAssessment独立于Reference，任意语义断言默认needs_judgment；可确定的“定位到了某原文”只代表定位。个人参与/量化成果请求缺独立材料标insufficient_evidence；自述和代码不升级independent_truth。来源相矛盾需显式证据，不凭词面编conflict。
- EvidencePack含pack/plan/config/trace身份、固定范围、两轮各自结果/原文引用/预算/降级/缺失、claim assessments、answer_policy（limited_source_only/needs_input）和visible_roles。所有状态有简短可审核理由，不存模型内部思维链。

## 场景与范围

输入“旧Worker回来了会不会覆盖新索引”，不能仅凭一个guard函数就说全部发布原子。先定位定义/发布证据，不足最多补一次，仍缺就返回可确认范围和缺什么。目标是有限检索决策和证据交接，不增加必调LLM分类器，不将“找齐几个文件”当语义支持，不把测试源码说成已跑测试。

备选无界自由工具循环难以保证预算；只跑一次top-k无法解释不足，采用规则计划+至多2检索轮+有限读取。来源原文仍不可信数据，指令不得扩展权限。

evaluate_case返回any-gold Hit、gold覆盖率、all/any充分证据、首gold MRR、原文引用有效率；无答案只报告retrieved_context_on_unanswerable，不能把“检索到了上下文”直接称幻觉。断言支持/最终业务质量未人工评判时为null。检索结果须包含可信doc/version/hash/范围/quote并回原文核对；不能拿命中替代支持。

1. InterviewTools新增retrieve_pack协调方法（不注册一个绕过计数的包装工具），每次search/get_symbol/find_references/read_code_range通过原run调用并计入state.tool_calls/指纹和18上限；计划自身不调用LLM。嵌套读取不得使用未计数的服务直连代替Agent选择的工具。原文校验属于确定性校验，不伪装额外模型决策。

class PDFRepository:
    def __init__(self, workspace):
        self.workspace = workspace
        with workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
            db.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rw_pdf_exports (
                export_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rw_versions(version_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                template TEXT NOT NULL, renderer TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                pdf_hash TEXT NOT NULL, pdf_bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(version_id, template, renderer))''')

    def export(self, owner, resume_id, version_id, request: PDFRequest):
        version = self.workspace.get_version(owner, resume_id, version_id)
        if version.content_hash != request.expected_content_hash:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_version_changed')
        if not version.confirmed_at:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_confirmation_required')
        export_id = 'pdf-' + sha256(f'{version_id}:{request.template}:{RENDERER_VERSION}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            existing = db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_pdf_exports WHERE export_id=?', (export_id,)).fetchone()
        if existing is None:
            data = render_pdf(version, request.template)
            with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
                self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
                self.workspace._version(db, resume_id, version_id)
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rw_pdf_exports VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                           (export_id, version_id, request.template, RENDERER_VERSION,
                            version.content_hash, sha256(data).hexdigest(), data))
        return self.metadata(owner, export_id)

    def _get(self, db, owner, export_id):
        row = db.execute('''SELECT e.*,v.resume_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
            JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id JOIN rw_resumes r ON r.resume_id=v.resume_id
            WHERE e.export_id=? AND r.owner_id=?''', (export_id, owner)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise WorkspaceNotFound('pdf_not_found')
        version = self.workspace._version(db, row['resume_id'], row['version_id'])
        self.workspace._validate_document(db, owner, version.document)
        if (row['content_hash'] != version.content_hash or not version.confirmed_at
                or sha256(row['pdf_bytes']).hexdigest() != row['pdf_hash']):
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_integrity_failed')
        return row

    def metadata(self, owner, export_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            row = self._get(db, owner, export_id)
            return {k:row[k] for k in ('export_id','resume_id','version_id','template','renderer','content_hash','pdf_hash')}

    def download(self, owner, export_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            return bytes(self._get(db, owner, export_id)['pdf_bytes'])

    def list(self, owner, resume_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
            ids = [r[0] for r in db.execute('''SELECT e.export_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
                JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id WHERE v.resume_id=?
                ORDER BY v.sequence DESC,e.template''', (resume_id,))]
        return [self.metadata(owner, key) for key in ids]

""" from reportlab.lib import colors from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_CENTER from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4 from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont from reportlab.pdfgen.canvas import Canvas from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, HRFlowable if template not in ('classic', 'compact'): raise WorkspaceConflict('unknown_pdf_template') if sum(len(f.text) for f in version.document.facts()) > 200_000: raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_content_limit') # Font registration is global in ReportLab, but no private font/data is global. with _FONT_LOCK: if 'JobAgentNoto' not in pdfmetrics.getRegisteredFontNames(): font_path = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets/NotoSansSC.ttf' if not font_path.is_file(): raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_font_asset_missing') pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont('JobAgentNoto', str(font_path))) compact = template == 'compact' accent = colors.HexColor('#173f50' if compact else '#26372c') body = ParagraphStyle('body', fontName='JobAgentNoto', fontSize=10 if compact else 11, leading=15 if compact else 17, wordWrap='CJK', spaceAfter=5) heading = ParagraphStyle('section', parent=body, fontSize=13, textColor=accent, spaceBefore=13, spaceAfter=7, keepWithNext=True) title = ParagraphStyle('name', parent=body, fontSize=24, leading=30, spaceAfter=10, alignment=TA_CENTER if compact else 0) sub = ParagraphStyle('entry', parent=body, fontSize=11, keepWithNext=True, spaceBefore=5, textColor=accent) story = [] def p(text, style=body): # Escape markup instead of interpreting applicant-provided tags/URLs. return Paragraph(escape(str(text)).replace('\n', '
'), style) def texts(items): return ' | '.join(x.text for x in items if x is not None) d = version.document story.append(p(d.personal.name.text, title)) contact = [d.personal.email, d.personal.phone, d.personal.location, *d.personal.links] if any(contact): story.append(p(texts(contact))) story.append(HRFlowable(width='100%', thickness=1, color=accent)) def section(label): story.append(p(label, heading)) if d.summary: section('个人简介') story.extend(p(f.text) for f in d.summary) for label, items, names, bullets in ( ('教育经历', d.education, ('school', 'degree', 'major', 'period'), 'highlights'), ('工作与实习', d.experience, ('organization', 'role', 'period'), 'bullets'), ('项目经历', d.projects, ('name', 'role', 'period'), 'bullets'), ): if not items: continue section(label) for item in items: story.append(p(texts([getattr(item, name) for name in names]), sub)) story.extend(p('• ' + f.text) for f in getattr(item, bullets)) if d.skills: section('技能') story.extend(p(f.text) for f in d.skills) buffer = BytesIO() margin = 36 if compact else 48 doc = SimpleDocTemplate(buffer, pagesize=A4, leftMargin=margin, rightMargin=margin, topMargin=margin, bottomMargin=42, title=d.personal.name.text, author='Job Agent', subject=f'{version.version_id}:{version.content_hash}') def footer(canvas, document): canvas.saveState() canvas.setFont('JobAgentNoto', 8) canvas.setFillColor(colors.HexColor('#64736d')) canvas.drawRightString(A4[0]-margin, 22, str(document.page)) canvas.restoreState() def invariant_canvas(*args, **kwargs): kwargs['invariant'] = 1

class PDFRepository:
    def __init__(self, workspace):
        self.workspace = workspace
        with workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
            db.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rw_pdf_exports (
                export_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rw_versions(version_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                template TEXT NOT NULL, renderer TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                pdf_hash TEXT NOT NULL, pdf_bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(version_id, template, renderer))''')

    def export(self, owner, resume_id, version_id, request: PDFRequest):
        version = self.workspace.get_version(owner, resume_id, version_id)
        if version.content_hash != request.expected_content_hash:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_version_changed')
        if not version.confirmed_at:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_confirmation_required')
        export_id = 'pdf-' + sha256(f'{version_id}:{request.template}:{RENDERER_VERSION}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            existing = db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_pdf_exports WHERE export_id=?', (export_id,)).fetchone()
        if existing is None:
            data = render_pdf(version, request.template)
            with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
                self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
                self.workspace._version(db, resume_id, version_id)
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rw_pdf_exports VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                           (export_id, version_id, request.template, RENDERER_VERSION,
                            version.content_hash, sha256(data).hexdigest(), data))
        return self.metadata(owner, export_id)

    def _get(self, db, owner, export_id):
        row = db.execute('''SELECT e.*,v.resume_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
            JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id JOIN rw_resumes r ON r.resume_id=v.resume_id
            WHERE e.export_id=? AND r.owner_id=?''', (export_id, owner)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise WorkspaceNotFound('pdf_not_found')
        version = self.workspace._version(db, row['resume_id'], row['version_id'])
        self.workspace._validate_document(db, owner, version.document)
        if (row['content_hash'] != version.content_hash or not version.confirmed_at
                or sha256(row['pdf_bytes']).hexdigest() != row['pdf_hash']):
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_integrity_failed')
        return row

    def metadata(self, owner, export_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            row = self._get(db, owner, export_id)
            return {k:row[k] for k in ('export_id','resume_id','version_id','template','renderer','content_hash','pdf_hash')}

    def download(self, owner, export_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            return bytes(self._get(db, owner, export_id)['pdf_bytes'])

    def list(self, owner, resume_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
            ids = [r[0] for r in db.execute('''SELECT e.export_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
                JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id WHERE v.resume_id=?
                ORDER BY v.sequence DESC,e.template''', (resume_id,))]
        return [self.metadata(owner, key) for key in ids]

def local_precheck(store: VersionSourceStore) -> tuple[RequirementAnalysis, EvidenceMappingV2]:
    """JD line/clause and literal-term inspection, not semantic atomization."""
    parents, atoms, results = [], [], []
    headers = {'岗位要求','岗位职责','任职要求','职位描述','职位要求','工作职责','加分项','requirements','responsibilities'}
    for part in re.finditer(r'[^\n；;]+', store.texts['jd']):
        raw = part.group()
        clean = re.sub(r'^\s*(?:[-•*]\s*|\d+[.、)]\s*)?', '', raw).strip()
        if not clean or clean.strip('：:').lower() in headers:
            continue
        if len(atoms) >= 24:
            break
        start = part.start() + raw.index(clean)
        span = store.make_span(store.catalog, 'jd', start, start + len(clean))
        n = len(atoms) + 1
        rid, aid = f'req_{n:03d}', f'atom_{n:03d}'
        importance = 'nice' if re.search('优先|加分|preferred|nice to have', clean, re.I) else 'must'
        parents.append(ParentRequirement(requirement_id=rid, text=clean, importance=importance, source_span=span, atom_ids=[aid]))
        atoms.append(RequirementAtom(atom_id=aid, parent_requirement_id=rid, text=clean, source_span=span))
        wanted = terms(clean)
        matches = []
        for sid, (path, fact) in store.origins.items():
            overlap = wanted & terms(fact.text)
            if overlap:
                matches.append((len(overlap), sid, fact))
        matches.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
        links = []
        for _, sid, fact in matches[:5]:
            negative = bool(re.search(r'不熟悉|未使用|没有使用|未进行|未独立|不具备|不掌握|无.{0,6}经验|\b(?:not|never|no experience)\b', fact.text, re.I))
            link_span = store.make_span(store.catalog, sid, 0, len(fact.text))
            links.append(EvidenceLink(link_id=f'{aid}-link-{len(links)}', atom_id=aid, source_span=link_span,
                                      claim=fact.text, support_status='contradictory' if negative else 'partial',
                                      level='C1', confidence=0.0, needs_confirmation=True,
                                      independence_group=store.independence_group(link_span)))
        results.append(AtomEvidenceResult(atom_id=aid, links=links,
            match_status=EvidenceMappingService._match_status(links), has_contradiction=any(l.support_status=='contradictory' for l in links),
            rationale='仅按已知术语查找原文，未判断语义支持；带否定/范围限定的材料需核对。' if links else
                      '当前所选版本未找到可自动定位的术语线索；可能是表述不同或材料缺失，不能推断你没有该能力。'))
    if not atoms:
        raise MatchError('jd_has_no_requirements')
    return (RequirementAnalysis(parents=parents, atoms=atoms, warnings=['local_clause_precheck_not_semantic_atoms','maximum_24_clauses']),
            EvidenceMappingV2(atom_results=results))

def import_project(self,owner,project_id,request:GitHubImport):
        self.store.get_project(owner,project_id)
        user,repo=repository_slug(request.url)
        if request.ref and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.\-/]{1,150}',request.ref):raise WorkspaceConflict('github_ref_invalid')
        supplied=self.client is not None
        client=self.client or httpx.Client(timeout=httpx.Timeout(25,connect=8),trust_env=False,follow_redirects=False)
        try:
            if re.fullmatch(r'[a-fA-F0-9]{40}',request.ref):
                # A full immutable SHA needs no branch resolver. The anonymous
                # official endpoint must return its git-archive commit comment,
                # so a 40-hex branch name cannot masquerade as a different commit.
                commit=request.ref.casefold()
                raw=self._download(client,f'https://codeload.github.com/{user}/{repo}/zip/{commit}',MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES)
                try:
                    with ZipFile(BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
                        if archive.comment.strip().decode('ascii').casefold()!=commit:raise WorkspaceConflict('github_archive_commit_mismatch')
                except (BadZipFile,UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('github_archive_commit_unverifiable') from exc
                files,safety=scan_zip(raw,strip_single_root=True)
                try:
                    declaration=tomllib.loads(files.get('pyproject.toml','')).get('project',{}).get('license','UNKNOWN')
                    license_value=declaration.get('text','UNKNOWN') if isinstance(declaration,dict) else declaration
                    if not isinstance(license_value,str) or len(license_value)>120:license_value='UNKNOWN'
                except (tomllib.TOMLDecodeError,TypeError):license_value='UNKNOWN'
                return self.store.publish_files(owner,project_id,files,origin='github',commit_sha=commit,metadata={
                    **safety,'repository_url':f'https://github.com/{user}/{repo}','license':license_value,
                    'license_basis':'upstream_pyproject_declaration_not_legal_review','source_ref':commit,
                    'public_access_basis':'anonymous_official_codeload','commit_verified_by':'git_archive_comment',
                    'private':False,'contribution_status':'self_attested_not_verified'})
            try:
                meta=json.loads(self._download(client,f'https://api.github.com/repos/{user}/{repo}',100000))
                if meta.get('private') is not False:raise WorkspaceConflict('private_repository_not_authorized')
                ref=request.ref or meta['default_branch']
                result=json.loads(self._download(client,f'https://api.github.com/repos/{user}/{repo}/commits/{quote(ref,safe="")}',200000))
                commit=result['sha']
                if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{40}',commit):raise WorkspaceConflict('github_commit_invalid')
            except WorkspaceConflict:raise
            except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError) as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('github_metadata_invalid') from exc
            raw=self._download(client,f'https://codeload.github.com/{user}/{repo}/zip/{commit}',MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES)
            files,safety=scan_zip(raw,strip_single_root=True)
            return self.store.publish_files(owner,project_id,files,origin='github',commit_sha=commit,metadata={
                **safety,'repository_url':f'https://github.com/{user}/{repo}','license':(meta.get('license') or {}).get('spdx_id','UNKNOWN'),
                'source_ref':str(ref)[:150],'private':False,'contribution_status':'self_attested_not_verified'})
        finally:
            if not supplied:client.close()

def _get(self, db, owner, export_id):
        row = db.execute('''SELECT e.*,v.resume_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
            JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id JOIN rw_resumes r ON r.resume_id=v.resume_id
            WHERE e.export_id=? AND r.owner_id=?''', (export_id, owner)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise WorkspaceNotFound('pdf_not_found')
        version = self.workspace._version(db, row['resume_id'], row['version_id'])
        self.workspace._validate_document(db, owner, version.document)
        if (row['content_hash'] != version.content_hash or not version.confirmed_at
                or sha256(row['pdf_bytes']).hexdigest() != row['pdf_hash']):
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_integrity_failed')
        return row

def export(self, owner, resume_id, version_id, request: PDFRequest):
        version = self.workspace.get_version(owner, resume_id, version_id)
        if version.content_hash != request.expected_content_hash:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_version_changed')
        if not version.confirmed_at:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_confirmation_required')
        export_id = 'pdf-' + sha256(f'{version_id}:{request.template}:{RENDERER_VERSION}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            existing = db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_pdf_exports WHERE export_id=?', (export_id,)).fetchone()
        if existing is None:
            data = render_pdf(version, request.template)
            with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
                self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
                self.workspace._version(db, resume_id, version_id)
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rw_pdf_exports VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                           (export_id, version_id, request.template, RENDERER_VERSION,
                            version.content_hash, sha256(data).hexdigest(), data))
        return self.metadata(owner, export_id)

def local_precheck(store: VersionSourceStore) -> tuple[RequirementAnalysis, EvidenceMappingV2]:
    """JD line/clause and literal-term inspection, not semantic atomization."""
    parents, atoms, results = [], [], []
    headers = {'岗位要求','岗位职责','任职要求','职位描述','职位要求','工作职责','加分项','requirements','responsibilities'}
    for part in re.finditer(r'[^\n；;]+', store.texts['jd']):
        raw = part.group()
        clean = re.sub(r'^\s*(?:[-•*]\s*|\d+[.、)]\s*)?', '', raw).strip()
        if not clean or clean.strip('：:').lower() in headers:
            continue
        if len(atoms) >= 24:
            break
        start = part.start() + raw.index(clean)
        span = store.make_span(store.catalog, 'jd', start, start + len(clean))
        n = len(atoms) + 1
        rid, aid = f'req_{n:03d}', f'atom_{n:03d}'
        importance = 'nice' if re.search('优先|加分|preferred|nice to have', clean, re.I) else 'must'
        parents.append(ParentRequirement(requirement_id=rid, text=clean, importance=importance, source_span=span, atom_ids=[aid]))
        atoms.append(RequirementAtom(atom_id=aid, parent_requirement_id=rid, text=clean, source_span=span))
        wanted = terms(clean)
        matches = []
        for sid, (path, fact) in store.origins.items():
            overlap = wanted & terms(fact.text)
            if overlap:
                matches.append((len(overlap), sid, fact))
        matches.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
        links = []
        for _, sid, fact in matches[:5]:
            negative = bool(re.search(r'不熟悉|未使用|没有使用|未进行|未独立|不具备|不掌握|无.{0,6}经验|\b(?:not|never|no experience)\b', fact.text, re.I))
            link_span = store.make_span(store.catalog, sid, 0, len(fact.text))
            links.append(EvidenceLink(link_id=f'{aid}-link-{len(links)}', atom_id=aid, source_span=link_span,
                                      claim=fact.text, support_status='contradictory' if negative else 'partial',
                                      level='C1', confidence=0.0, needs_confirmation=True,
                                      independence_group=store.independence_group(link_span)))
        results.append(AtomEvidenceResult(atom_id=aid, links=links,
            match_status=EvidenceMappingService._match_status(links), has_contradiction=any(l.support_status=='contradictory' for l in links),
            rationale='仅按已知术语查找原文，未判断语义支持；带否定/范围限定的材料需核对。' if links else
                      '当前所选版本未找到可自动定位的术语线索；可能是表述不同或材料缺失，不能推断你没有该能力。'))
    if not atoms:
        raise MatchError('jd_has_no_requirements')
    return (RequirementAnalysis(parents=parents, atoms=atoms, warnings=['local_clause_precheck_not_semantic_atoms','maximum_24_clauses']),
            EvidenceMappingV2(atom_results=results))

class WorkbenchMatcher:
    def __init__(self, provider=None):
        self.provider = provider

    def analyze(self, match_id: str, version: VersionRecord, request: AnalyzeRequest) -> MatchPayload:
        store = VersionSourceStore(version, request.jd_text)
        if len(store.facts) > 300 or sum(map(len,store.texts.values())) > 30_000:
            raise MatchError('match_input_too_large')
        usage = ParseUsage()
        started = perf_counter()
        if request.mode == 'local_check':
            requirements, mapping = local_precheck(store)
            provider, model = 'python', 'local-clause-term-precheck-v1'
        else:
            if self.provider is None:
                raise MatchError('match_model_unavailable')
            if not request.allow_external_processing:
                raise MatchError('external_processing_consent_required')
            bounded = BoundedProvider(self.provider)
            harness = LLMHarness(bounded)
            requirements = RequirementAnalyzer(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).analyze(
                store.catalog.documents[0],catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            mapping = EvidenceMappingService(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).map(
                requirements,catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            usage.provider_calls = bounded.calls
            for key in ('input_tokens','output_tokens'):
                values = [getattr(t,key) for t in harness.traces]
                setattr(usage,key,sum(values) if values and all(v is not None for v in values) else None)
            provider, model = str(bounded.provider_name), str(bounded.model)
        config = initial_fit_policy_v2()
        bundle = EvidenceBundle(manifest=EvidenceRunManifest(run_id=match_id,created_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            jd_parser_version='workbench-m3-existing-evidence-v2' if request.mode=='llm' else 'local-clauses-v1',
            evidence_prompt_version='workbench-m3-C1-only', fit_policy_version=config.version,
            provider=provider,model=model,source_fingerprint=digest(''.join(d.content_hash for d in store.catalog.documents))),
            sources=store.catalog,requirements=requirements,mapping=mapping,
            assessment=FitAssessmentPolicy().assess(requirements,mapping,config=config))
        validate_bundle(store,bundle)
        usage.latency_ms = max(0,int((perf_counter()-started)*1000))
        return MatchPayload(match_id=match_id,resume_id=version.resume_id,version_id=version.version_id,
            version_hash=version.content_hash,title=request.title,jd_text=request.jd_text,mode=request.mode,bundle=bundle,

            self.workspace._validate_document(db,owner,version.document)

                       (encoded,digest(encoded),match_id))

            or payload.bundle.manifest.run_id!=row['match_id']):
            raise InvalidProvenance('match_integrity_failed')
        row_views(payload,version)  # Hash/quote/C1/JD exclusion validated on write and read.
        expected = propose_order(version,VersionSourceStore(version,payload.jd_text),payload.bundle)
        if payload.proposals != expected:
            raise InvalidProvenance('match_proposals_changed')

    def _load(self, db, owner, match_id):
        row = self._row(db,owner,match_id)
        if row['status'] != 'complete':raise WorkspaceConflict('match_not_complete')
        if digest(row['payload_json'])!=row['payload_hash']:
            raise InvalidProvenance('match_integrity_failed')
        payload = MatchPayload.model_validate_json(row['payload_json'])
        version = self.workspace._version(db,row['resume_id'],row['version_id'])
        self.workspace._validate_document(db,owner,version.document)
        self._validate_payload(row,payload,version)
        return row, payload, version

    def _view(self, db, owner, match_id):
        row,payload,version = self._load(db,owner,match_id)

def local_precheck(store: VersionSourceStore) -> tuple[RequirementAnalysis, EvidenceMappingV2]:
    """JD line/clause and literal-term inspection, not semantic atomization."""
    parents, atoms, results = [], [], []
    headers = {'岗位要求','岗位职责','任职要求','职位描述','职位要求','工作职责','加分项','requirements','responsibilities'}
    for part in re.finditer(r'[^\n；;]+', store.texts['jd']):
        raw = part.group()
        clean = re.sub(r'^\s*(?:[-•*]\s*|\d+[.、)]\s*)?', '', raw).strip()
        if not clean or clean.strip('：:').lower() in headers:
            continue
        if len(atoms) >= 24:
            break
        start = part.start() + raw.index(clean)
        span = store.make_span(store.catalog, 'jd', start, start + len(clean))
        n = len(atoms) + 1
        rid, aid = f'req_{n:03d}', f'atom_{n:03d}'
        importance = 'nice' if re.search('优先|加分|preferred|nice to have', clean, re.I) else 'must'
        parents.append(ParentRequirement(requirement_id=rid, text=clean, importance=importance, source_span=span, atom_ids=[aid]))
        atoms.append(RequirementAtom(atom_id=aid, parent_requirement_id=rid, text=clean, source_span=span))
        wanted = terms(clean)
        matches = []
        for sid, (path, fact) in store.origins.items():
            overlap = wanted & terms(fact.text)
            if overlap:
                matches.append((len(overlap), sid, fact))
        matches.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
        links = []
        for _, sid, fact in matches[:5]:
            negative = bool(re.search(r'不熟悉|未使用|没有使用|未进行|未独立|不具备|不掌握|无.{0,6}经验|\b(?:not|never|no experience)\b', fact.text, re.I))
            link_span = store.make_span(store.catalog, sid, 0, len(fact.text))
            links.append(EvidenceLink(link_id=f'{aid}-link-{len(links)}', atom_id=aid, source_span=link_span,
                                      claim=fact.text, support_status='contradictory' if negative else 'partial',
                                      level='C1', confidence=0.0, needs_confirmation=True,
                                      independence_group=store.independence_group(link_span)))
        results.append(AtomEvidenceResult(atom_id=aid, links=links,
            match_status=EvidenceMappingService._match_status(links), has_contradiction=any(l.support_status=='contradictory' for l in links),
            rationale='仅按已知术语查找原文，未判断语义支持；带否定/范围限定的材料需核对。' if links else
                      '当前所选版本未找到可自动定位的术语线索；可能是表述不同或材料缺失，不能推断你没有该能力。'))
    if not atoms:
        raise MatchError('jd_has_no_requirements')
    return (RequirementAnalysis(parents=parents, atoms=atoms, warnings=['local_clause_precheck_not_semantic_atoms','maximum_24_clauses']),
            EvidenceMappingV2(atom_results=results))

def row_views(payload: MatchPayload, version: VersionRecord) -> list[MatchRowView]:
    store = VersionSourceStore(version,payload.jd_text)
    validate_bundle(store,payload.bundle)
    results = {r.atom_id:r for r in payload.bundle.mapping.atom_results}
    parents = {p.requirement_id:p for p in payload.bundle.requirements.parents}
    rows = []
    for atom in payload.bundle.requirements.atoms:
        result = results[atom.atom_id]
        links = []
        for link in result.links:
            path, fact = store.origins[link.source_span.source_id]
            span = link.source_span
            original_span = fact.source.model_copy(update={'start':fact.source.start+span.start_offset,'end':fact.source.start+span.end_offset})
            links.append(MatchLinkView(path=path,quote=span.exact_quote,
                fact=fact.model_copy(update={'text':span.exact_quote,'source':original_span}),support_status=link.support_status))
        rows.append(MatchRowView(atom_id=atom.atom_id,text=atom.text,importance=parents[atom.parent_requirement_id].importance,
            jd_quote=atom.source_span.exact_quote,jd_start=atom.source_span.start_offset,jd_end=atom.source_span.end_offset,
            match_status=result.match_status,has_contradiction=result.has_contradiction,rationale=result.rationale,links=links))
    return rows

def local_precheck(store: VersionSourceStore) -> tuple[RequirementAnalysis, EvidenceMappingV2]:
    """JD line/clause and literal-term inspection, not semantic atomization."""
    parents, atoms, results = [], [], []
    headers = {'岗位要求','岗位职责','任职要求','职位描述','职位要求','工作职责','加分项','requirements','responsibilities'}
    for part in re.finditer(r'[^\n；;]+', store.texts['jd']):
        raw = part.group()
        clean = re.sub(r'^\s*(?:[-•*]\s*|\d+[.、)]\s*)?', '', raw).strip()
        if not clean or clean.strip('：:').lower() in headers:
            continue
        if len(atoms) >= 24:
            break
        start = part.start() + raw.index(clean)
        span = store.make_span(store.catalog, 'jd', start, start + len(clean))
        n = len(atoms) + 1
        rid, aid = f'req_{n:03d}', f'atom_{n:03d}'
        importance = 'nice' if re.search('优先|加分|preferred|nice to have', clean, re.I) else 'must'
        parents.append(ParentRequirement(requirement_id=rid, text=clean, importance=importance, source_span=span, atom_ids=[aid]))
        atoms.append(RequirementAtom(atom_id=aid, parent_requirement_id=rid, text=clean, source_span=span))
        wanted = terms(clean)
        matches = []
        for sid, (path, fact) in store.origins.items():
            overlap = wanted & terms(fact.text)
            if overlap:
                matches.append((len(overlap), sid, fact))
        matches.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
        links = []
        for _, sid, fact in matches[:5]:
            negative = bool(re.search(r'不熟悉|未使用|没有使用|未进行|未独立|不具备|不掌握|无.{0,6}经验|\b(?:not|never|no experience)\b', fact.text, re.I))
            link_span = store.make_span(store.catalog, sid, 0, len(fact.text))
            links.append(EvidenceLink(link_id=f'{aid}-link-{len(links)}', atom_id=aid, source_span=link_span,
                                      claim=fact.text, support_status='contradictory' if negative else 'partial',
                                      level='C1', confidence=0.0, needs_confirmation=True,
                                      independence_group=store.independence_group(link_span)))
        results.append(AtomEvidenceResult(atom_id=aid, links=links,
            match_status=EvidenceMappingService._match_status(links), has_contradiction=any(l.support_status=='contradictory' for l in links),
            rationale='仅按已知术语查找原文，未判断语义支持；带否定/范围限定的材料需核对。' if links else
                      '当前所选版本未找到可自动定位的术语线索；可能是表述不同或材料缺失，不能推断你没有该能力。'))
    if not atoms:
        raise MatchError('jd_has_no_requirements')
    return (RequirementAnalysis(parents=parents, atoms=atoms, warnings=['local_clause_precheck_not_semantic_atoms','maximum_24_clauses']),
            EvidenceMappingV2(atom_results=results))

## 首个增量合同

`knowledge/index_manifest.py`新增EmbeddingIdentity（provider/model/revision/dimension/normalization/query_template）和IndexManifest（corpus_kind/scope/input_hash/parser_version/splitter_version/embedding）。规范JSON→SHA256；任何一项变化都失效。scope来自可信服务owner/project/snapshot或public，先鉴权再编码。input_hash包含实际embedding文本及顺序，不只chunk_id。

CodeRAG复用现有vectors表model_id字段保存manifest键，无破坏性DDL；旧键不静默复用，重建沿用级联。Public缓存同身份，引用仍用title/body，不能引用tags或私有rubric。维度/有限值/非零验证保留。测试替身身份明确test，不算真实模型。

## 数据与状态合同

新增resume_workspace/evidence_pack.py：

class WorkbenchMatcher:
    def __init__(self, provider=None):
        self.provider = provider

    def analyze(self, match_id: str, version: VersionRecord, request: AnalyzeRequest) -> MatchPayload:
        store = VersionSourceStore(version, request.jd_text)
        if len(store.facts) > 300 or sum(map(len,store.texts.values())) > 30_000:
            raise MatchError('match_input_too_large')
        usage = ParseUsage()
        started = perf_counter()
        if request.mode == 'local_check':
            requirements, mapping = local_precheck(store)
            provider, model = 'python', 'local-clause-term-precheck-v1'
        else:
            if self.provider is None:
                raise MatchError('match_model_unavailable')
            if not request.allow_external_processing:
                raise MatchError('external_processing_consent_required')
            bounded = BoundedProvider(self.provider)
            harness = LLMHarness(bounded)
            requirements = RequirementAnalyzer(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).analyze(
                store.catalog.documents[0],catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            mapping = EvidenceMappingService(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).map(
                requirements,catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            usage.provider_calls = bounded.calls
            for key in ('input_tokens','output_tokens'):
                values = [getattr(t,key) for t in harness.traces]
                setattr(usage,key,sum(values) if values and all(v is not None for v in values) else None)
            provider, model = str(bounded.provider_name), str(bounded.model)
        config = initial_fit_policy_v2()
        bundle = EvidenceBundle(manifest=EvidenceRunManifest(run_id=match_id,created_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            jd_parser_version='workbench-m3-existing-evidence-v2' if request.mode=='llm' else 'local-clauses-v1',
            evidence_prompt_version='workbench-m3-C1-only', fit_policy_version=config.version,
            provider=provider,model=model,source_fingerprint=digest(''.join(d.content_hash for d in store.catalog.documents))),
            sources=store.catalog,requirements=requirements,mapping=mapping,
            assessment=FitAssessmentPolicy().assess(requirements,mapping,config=config))
        validate_bundle(store,bundle)
        usage.latency_ms = max(0,int((perf_counter()-started)*1000))
        return MatchPayload(match_id=match_id,resume_id=version.resume_id,version_id=version.version_id,
            version_hash=version.content_hash,title=request.title,jd_text=request.jd_text,mode=request.mode,bundle=bundle,
            proposals=propose_order(version,store,bundle),usage=usage,created_at=datetime.now(UTC))

class WorkbenchMatcher:
    def __init__(self, provider=None):
        self.provider = provider

    def analyze(self, match_id: str, version: VersionRecord, request: AnalyzeRequest) -> MatchPayload:
        store = VersionSourceStore(version, request.jd_text)
        if len(store.facts) > 300 or sum(map(len,store.texts.values())) > 30_000:
            raise MatchError('match_input_too_large')
        usage = ParseUsage()
        started = perf_counter()
        if request.mode == 'local_check':
            requirements, mapping = local_precheck(store)
            provider, model = 'python', 'local-clause-term-precheck-v1'
        else:
            if self.provider is None:
                raise MatchError('match_model_unavailable')
            if not request.allow_external_processing:
                raise MatchError('external_processing_consent_required')
            bounded = BoundedProvider(self.provider)
            harness = LLMHarness(bounded)
            requirements = RequirementAnalyzer(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).analyze(
                store.catalog.documents[0],catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            mapping = EvidenceMappingService(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).map(
                requirements,catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            usage.provider_calls = bounded.calls
            for key in ('input_tokens','output_tokens'):
                values = [getattr(t,key) for t in harness.traces]
                setattr(usage,key,sum(values) if values and all(v is not None for v in values) else None)
            provider, model = str(bounded.provider_name), str(bounded.model)
        config = initial_fit_policy_v2()
        bundle = EvidenceBundle(manifest=EvidenceRunManifest(run_id=match_id,created_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            jd_parser_version='workbench-m3-existing-evidence-v2' if request.mode=='llm' else 'local-clauses-v1',
            evidence_prompt_version='workbench-m3-C1-only', fit_policy_version=config.version,
            provider=provider,model=model,source_fingerprint=digest(''.join(d.content_hash for d in store.catalog.documents))),
            sources=store.catalog,requirements=requirements,mapping=mapping,
            assessment=FitAssessmentPolicy().assess(requirements,mapping,config=config))
        validate_bundle(store,bundle)
        usage.latency_ms = max(0,int((perf_counter()-started)*1000))
        return MatchPayload(match_id=match_id,resume_id=version.resume_id,version_id=version.version_id,
            version_hash=version.content_hash,title=request.title,jd_text=request.jd_text,mode=request.mode,bundle=bundle,
            proposals=propose_order(version,store,bundle),usage=usage,created_at=datetime.now(UTC))

class PDFRepository:
    def __init__(self, workspace):
        self.workspace = workspace
        with workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
            db.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rw_pdf_exports (
                export_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rw_versions(version_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                template TEXT NOT NULL, renderer TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                pdf_hash TEXT NOT NULL, pdf_bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(version_id, template, renderer))''')

    def export(self, owner, resume_id, version_id, request: PDFRequest):
        version = self.workspace.get_version(owner, resume_id, version_id)
        if version.content_hash != request.expected_content_hash:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_version_changed')
        if not version.confirmed_at:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_confirmation_required')
        export_id = 'pdf-' + sha256(f'{version_id}:{request.template}:{RENDERER_VERSION}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            existing = db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_pdf_exports WHERE export_id=?', (export_id,)).fetchone()
        if existing is None:
            data = render_pdf(version, request.template)
            with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
                self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
                self.workspace._version(db, resume_id, version_id)
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rw_pdf_exports VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                           (export_id, version_id, request.template, RENDERER_VERSION,
                            version.content_hash, sha256(data).hexdigest(), data))
        return self.metadata(owner, export_id)

    def _get(self, db, owner, export_id):
        row = db.execute('''SELECT e.*,v.resume_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
            JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id JOIN rw_resumes r ON r.resume_id=v.resume_id
            WHERE e.export_id=? AND r.owner_id=?''', (export_id, owner)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise WorkspaceNotFound('pdf_not_found')
        version = self.workspace._version(db, row['resume_id'], row['version_id'])
        self.workspace._validate_document(db, owner, version.document)
        if (row['content_hash'] != version.content_hash or not version.confirmed_at
                or sha256(row['pdf_bytes']).hexdigest() != row['pdf_hash']):
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_integrity_failed')
        return row

    def metadata(self, owner, export_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            row = self._get(db, owner, export_id)
            return {k:row[k] for k in ('export_id','resume_id','version_id','template','renderer','content_hash','pdf_hash')}

    def download(self, owner, export_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            return bytes(self._get(db, owner, export_id)['pdf_bytes'])

    def list(self, owner, resume_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
            ids = [r[0] for r in db.execute('''SELECT e.export_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
                JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id WHERE v.resume_id=?
                ORDER BY v.sequence DESC,e.template''', (resume_id,))]
        return [self.metadata(owner, key) for key in ids]

class PDFRepository:
    def __init__(self, workspace):
        self.workspace = workspace
        with workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
            db.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rw_pdf_exports (
                export_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rw_versions(version_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                template TEXT NOT NULL, renderer TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                pdf_hash TEXT NOT NULL, pdf_bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(version_id, template, renderer))''')

    def export(self, owner, resume_id, version_id, request: PDFRequest):
        version = self.workspace.get_version(owner, resume_id, version_id)
        if version.content_hash != request.expected_content_hash:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_version_changed')
        if not version.confirmed_at:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_confirmation_required')
        export_id = 'pdf-' + sha256(f'{version_id}:{request.template}:{RENDERER_VERSION}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            existing = db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_pdf_exports WHERE export_id=?', (export_id,)).fetchone()
        if existing is None:
            data = render_pdf(version, request.template)
            with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
                self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
                self.workspace._version(db, resume_id, version_id)
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rw_pdf_exports VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                           (export_id, version_id, request.template, RENDERER_VERSION,
                            version.content_hash, sha256(data).hexdigest(), data))
        return self.metadata(owner, export_id)

    def _get(self, db, owner, export_id):
        row = db.execute('''SELECT e.*,v.resume_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
            JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id JOIN rw_resumes r ON r.resume_id=v.resume_id
            WHERE e.export_id=? AND r.owner_id=?''', (export_id, owner)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise WorkspaceNotFound('pdf_not_found')
        version = self.workspace._version(db, row['resume_id'], row['version_id'])
        self.workspace._validate_document(db, owner, version.document)
        if (row['content_hash'] != version.content_hash or not version.confirmed_at
                or sha256(row['pdf_bytes']).hexdigest() != row['pdf_hash']):
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_integrity_failed')
        return row

    def metadata(self, owner, export_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            row = self._get(db, owner, export_id)
            return {k:row[k] for k in ('export_id','resume_id','version_id','template','renderer','content_hash','pdf_hash')}

    def download(self, owner, export_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            return bytes(self._get(db, owner, export_id)['pdf_bytes'])

    def list(self, owner, resume_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
            ids = [r[0] for r in db.execute('''SELECT e.export_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
                JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id WHERE v.resume_id=?
                ORDER BY v.sequence DESC,e.template''', (resume_id,))]
        return [self.metadata(owner, key) for key in ids]

class WorkbenchMatcher:
    def __init__(self, provider=None):
        self.provider = provider

    def analyze(self, match_id: str, version: VersionRecord, request: AnalyzeRequest) -> MatchPayload:
        store = VersionSourceStore(version, request.jd_text)
        if len(store.facts) > 300 or sum(map(len,store.texts.values())) > 30_000:
            raise MatchError('match_input_too_large')
        usage = ParseUsage()
        started = perf_counter()
        if request.mode == 'local_check':
            requirements, mapping = local_precheck(store)
            provider, model = 'python', 'local-clause-term-precheck-v1'
        else:
            if self.provider is None:
                raise MatchError('match_model_unavailable')
            if not request.allow_external_processing:
                raise MatchError('external_processing_consent_required')
            bounded = BoundedProvider(self.provider)
            harness = LLMHarness(bounded)
            requirements = RequirementAnalyzer(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).analyze(
                store.catalog.documents[0],catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            mapping = EvidenceMappingService(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).map(
                requirements,catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            usage.provider_calls = bounded.calls
            for key in ('input_tokens','output_tokens'):
                values = [getattr(t,key) for t in harness.traces]
                setattr(usage,key,sum(values) if values and all(v is not None for v in values) else None)
            provider, model = str(bounded.provider_name), str(bounded.model)
        config = initial_fit_policy_v2()
        bundle = EvidenceBundle(manifest=EvidenceRunManifest(run_id=match_id,created_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            jd_parser_version='workbench-m3-existing-evidence-v2' if request.mode=='llm' else 'local-clauses-v1',
            evidence_prompt_version='workbench-m3-C1-only', fit_policy_version=config.version,
            provider=provider,model=model,source_fingerprint=digest(''.join(d.content_hash for d in store.catalog.documents))),
            sources=store.catalog,requirements=requirements,mapping=mapping,
            assessment=FitAssessmentPolicy().assess(requirements,mapping,config=config))
        validate_bundle(store,bundle)
        usage.latency_ms = max(0,int((perf_counter()-started)*1000))
        return MatchPayload(match_id=match_id,resume_id=version.resume_id,version_id=version.version_id,
            version_hash=version.content_hash,title=request.title,jd_text=request.jd_text,mode=request.mode,bundle=bundle,
            proposals=propose_order(version,store,bundle),usage=usage,created_at=datetime.now(UTC))

def import_project(self,owner,project_id,request:GitHubImport):
        self.store.get_project(owner,project_id)
        user,repo=repository_slug(request.url)
        if request.ref and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.\-/]{1,150}',request.ref):raise WorkspaceConflict('github_ref_invalid')
        supplied=self.client is not None
        client=self.client or httpx.Client(timeout=httpx.Timeout(25,connect=8),trust_env=False,follow_redirects=False)
        try:
            if re.fullmatch(r'[a-fA-F0-9]{40}',request.ref):
                # A full immutable SHA needs no branch resolver. The anonymous
                # official endpoint must return its git-archive commit comment,
                # so a 40-hex branch name cannot masquerade as a different commit.
                commit=request.ref.casefold()
                raw=self._download(client,f'https://codeload.github.com/{user}/{repo}/zip/{commit}',MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES)
                try:
                    with ZipFile(BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
                        if archive.comment.strip().decode('ascii').casefold()!=commit:raise WorkspaceConflict('github_archive_commit_mismatch')
                except (BadZipFile,UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('github_archive_commit_unverifiable') from exc
                files,safety=scan_zip(raw,strip_single_root=True)
                try:
                    declaration=tomllib.loads(files.get('pyproject.toml','')).get('project',{}).get('license','UNKNOWN')
                    license_value=declaration.get('text','UNKNOWN') if isinstance(declaration,dict) else declaration
                    if not isinstance(license_value,str) or len(license_value)>120:license_value='UNKNOWN'
                except (tomllib.TOMLDecodeError,TypeError):license_value='UNKNOWN'
                return self.store.publish_files(owner,project_id,files,origin='github',commit_sha=commit,metadata={
                    **safety,'repository_url':f'https://github.com/{user}/{repo}','license':license_value,
                    'license_basis':'upstream_pyproject_declaration_not_legal_review','source_ref':commit,
                    'public_access_basis':'anonymous_official_codeload','commit_verified_by':'git_archive_comment',
                    'private':False,'contribution_status':'self_attested_not_verified'})
            try:
                meta=json.loads(self._download(client,f'https://api.github.com/repos/{user}/{repo}',100000))
                if meta.get('private') is not False:raise WorkspaceConflict('private_repository_not_authorized')
                ref=request.ref or meta['default_branch']
                result=json.loads(self._download(client,f'https://api.github.com/repos/{user}/{repo}/commits/{quote(ref,safe="")}',200000))
                commit=result['sha']
                if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{40}',commit):raise WorkspaceConflict('github_commit_invalid')
            except WorkspaceConflict:raise
            except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError) as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('github_metadata_invalid') from exc
            raw=self._download(client,f'https://codeload.github.com/{user}/{repo}/zip/{commit}',MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES)
            files,safety=scan_zip(raw,strip_single_root=True)
            return self.store.publish_files(owner,project_id,files,origin='github',commit_sha=commit,metadata={
                **safety,'repository_url':f'https://github.com/{user}/{repo}','license':(meta.get('license') or {}).get('spdx_id','UNKNOWN'),
                'source_ref':str(ref)[:150],'private':False,'contribution_status':'self_attested_not_verified'})
        finally:
            if not supplied:client.close()

def local_precheck(store: VersionSourceStore) -> tuple[RequirementAnalysis, EvidenceMappingV2]:
    """JD line/clause and literal-term inspection, not semantic atomization."""
    parents, atoms, results = [], [], []
    headers = {'岗位要求','岗位职责','任职要求','职位描述','职位要求','工作职责','加分项','requirements','responsibilities'}
    for part in re.finditer(r'[^\n；;]+', store.texts['jd']):
        raw = part.group()
        clean = re.sub(r'^\s*(?:[-•*]\s*|\d+[.、)]\s*)?', '', raw).strip()
        if not clean or clean.strip('：:').lower() in headers:
            continue
        if len(atoms) >= 24:
            break
        start = part.start() + raw.index(clean)
        span = store.make_span(store.catalog, 'jd', start, start + len(clean))
        n = len(atoms) + 1
        rid, aid = f'req_{n:03d}', f'atom_{n:03d}'
        importance = 'nice' if re.search('优先|加分|preferred|nice to have', clean, re.I) else 'must'
        parents.append(ParentRequirement(requirement_id=rid, text=clean, importance=importance, source_span=span, atom_ids=[aid]))
        atoms.append(RequirementAtom(atom_id=aid, parent_requirement_id=rid, text=clean, source_span=span))
        wanted = terms(clean)
        matches = []
        for sid, (path, fact) in store.origins.items():
            overlap = wanted & terms(fact.text)
            if overlap:
                matches.append((len(overlap), sid, fact))
        matches.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
        links = []
        for _, sid, fact in matches[:5]:
            negative = bool(re.search(r'不熟悉|未使用|没有使用|未进行|未独立|不具备|不掌握|无.{0,6}经验|\b(?:not|never|no experience)\b', fact.text, re.I))
            link_span = store.make_span(store.catalog, sid, 0, len(fact.text))
            links.append(EvidenceLink(link_id=f'{aid}-link-{len(links)}', atom_id=aid, source_span=link_span,
                                      claim=fact.text, support_status='contradictory' if negative else 'partial',
                                      level='C1', confidence=0.0, needs_confirmation=True,
                                      independence_group=store.independence_group(link_span)))
        results.append(AtomEvidenceResult(atom_id=aid, links=links,
            match_status=EvidenceMappingService._match_status(links), has_contradiction=any(l.support_status=='contradictory' for l in links),
            rationale='仅按已知术语查找原文，未判断语义支持；带否定/范围限定的材料需核对。' if links else
                      '当前所选版本未找到可自动定位的术语线索；可能是表述不同或材料缺失，不能推断你没有该能力。'))
    if not atoms:
        raise MatchError('jd_has_no_requirements')
    return (RequirementAnalysis(parents=parents, atoms=atoms, warnings=['local_clause_precheck_not_semantic_atoms','maximum_24_clauses']),
            EvidenceMappingV2(atom_results=results))

class WorkbenchMatcher:
    def __init__(self, provider=None):
        self.provider = provider

    def analyze(self, match_id: str, version: VersionRecord, request: AnalyzeRequest) -> MatchPayload:
        store = VersionSourceStore(version, request.jd_text)
        if len(store.facts) > 300 or sum(map(len,store.texts.values())) > 30_000:
            raise MatchError('match_input_too_large')
        usage = ParseUsage()
        started = perf_counter()
        if request.mode == 'local_check':
            requirements, mapping = local_precheck(store)
            provider, model = 'python', 'local-clause-term-precheck-v1'
        else:
            if self.provider is None:
                raise MatchError('match_model_unavailable')
            if not request.allow_external_processing:
                raise MatchError('external_processing_consent_required')
            bounded = BoundedProvider(self.provider)
            harness = LLMHarness(bounded)
            requirements = RequirementAnalyzer(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).analyze(
                store.catalog.documents[0],catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            mapping = EvidenceMappingService(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).map(
                requirements,catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            usage.provider_calls = bounded.calls
            for key in ('input_tokens','output_tokens'):
                values = [getattr(t,key) for t in harness.traces]
                setattr(usage,key,sum(values) if values and all(v is not None for v in values) else None)
            provider, model = str(bounded.provider_name), str(bounded.model)
        config = initial_fit_policy_v2()
        bundle = EvidenceBundle(manifest=EvidenceRunManifest(run_id=match_id,created_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            jd_parser_version='workbench-m3-existing-evidence-v2' if request.mode=='llm' else 'local-clauses-v1',
            evidence_prompt_version='workbench-m3-C1-only', fit_policy_version=config.version,
            provider=provider,model=model,source_fingerprint=digest(''.join(d.content_hash for d in store.catalog.documents))),
            sources=store.catalog,requirements=requirements,mapping=mapping,
            assessment=FitAssessmentPolicy().assess(requirements,mapping,config=config))
        validate_bundle(store,bundle)
        usage.latency_ms = max(0,int((perf_counter()-started)*1000))
        return MatchPayload(match_id=match_id,resume_id=version.resume_id,version_id=version.version_id,
            version_hash=version.content_hash,title=request.title,jd_text=request.jd_text,mode=request.mode,bundle=bundle,
            proposals=propose_order(version,store,bundle),usage=usage,created_at=datetime.now(UTC))

def import_project(self,owner,project_id,request:GitHubImport):
        self.store.get_project(owner,project_id)
        user,repo=repository_slug(request.url)
        if request.ref and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.\-/]{1,150}',request.ref):raise WorkspaceConflict('github_ref_invalid')
        supplied=self.client is not None
        client=self.client or httpx.Client(timeout=httpx.Timeout(25,connect=8),trust_env=False,follow_redirects=False)
        try:
            if re.fullmatch(r'[a-fA-F0-9]{40}',request.ref):
                # A full immutable SHA needs no branch resolver. The anonymous
                # official endpoint must return its git-archive commit comment,
                # so a 40-hex branch name cannot masquerade as a different commit.
                commit=request.ref.casefold()
                raw=self._download(client,f'https://codeload.github.com/{user}/{repo}/zip/{commit}',MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES)
                try:
                    with ZipFile(BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
                        if archive.comment.strip().decode('ascii').casefold()!=commit:raise WorkspaceConflict('github_archive_commit_mismatch')
                except (BadZipFile,UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('github_archive_commit_unverifiable') from exc
                files,safety=scan_zip(raw,strip_single_root=True)
                try:
                    declaration=tomllib.loads(files.get('pyproject.toml','')).get('project',{}).get('license','UNKNOWN')
                    license_value=declaration.get('text','UNKNOWN') if isinstance(declaration,dict) else declaration
                    if not isinstance(license_value,str) or len(license_value)>120:license_value='UNKNOWN'
                except (tomllib.TOMLDecodeError,TypeError):license_value='UNKNOWN'
                return self.store.publish_files(owner,project_id,files,origin='github',commit_sha=commit,metadata={
                    **safety,'repository_url':f'https://github.com/{user}/{repo}','license':license_value,
                    'license_basis':'upstream_pyproject_declaration_not_legal_review','source_ref':commit,
                    'public_access_basis':'anonymous_official_codeload','commit_verified_by':'git_archive_comment',
                    'private':False,'contribution_status':'self_attested_not_verified'})
            try:
                meta=json.loads(self._download(client,f'https://api.github.com/repos/{user}/{repo}',100000))
                if meta.get('private') is not False:raise WorkspaceConflict('private_repository_not_authorized')
                ref=request.ref or meta['default_branch']
                result=json.loads(self._download(client,f'https://api.github.com/repos/{user}/{repo}/commits/{quote(ref,safe="")}',200000))
                commit=result['sha']
                if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{40}',commit):raise WorkspaceConflict('github_commit_invalid')
            except WorkspaceConflict:raise
            except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError) as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('github_metadata_invalid') from exc
            raw=self._download(client,f'https://codeload.github.com/{user}/{repo}/zip/{commit}',MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES)
            files,safety=scan_zip(raw,strip_single_root=True)
            return self.store.publish_files(owner,project_id,files,origin='github',commit_sha=commit,metadata={
                **safety,'repository_url':f'https://github.com/{user}/{repo}','license':(meta.get('license') or {}).get('spdx_id','UNKNOWN'),
                'source_ref':str(ref)[:150],'private':False,'contribution_status':'self_attested_not_verified'})
        finally:
            if not supplied:client.close()

def local_precheck(store: VersionSourceStore) -> tuple[RequirementAnalysis, EvidenceMappingV2]:
    """JD line/clause and literal-term inspection, not semantic atomization."""
    parents, atoms, results = [], [], []
    headers = {'岗位要求','岗位职责','任职要求','职位描述','职位要求','工作职责','加分项','requirements','responsibilities'}
    for part in re.finditer(r'[^\n；;]+', store.texts['jd']):
        raw = part.group()
        clean = re.sub(r'^\s*(?:[-•*]\s*|\d+[.、)]\s*)?', '', raw).strip()
        if not clean or clean.strip('：:').lower() in headers:
            continue
        if len(atoms) >= 24:
            break
        start = part.start() + raw.index(clean)
        span = store.make_span(store.catalog, 'jd', start, start + len(clean))
        n = len(atoms) + 1
        rid, aid = f'req_{n:03d}', f'atom_{n:03d}'
        importance = 'nice' if re.search('优先|加分|preferred|nice to have', clean, re.I) else 'must'
        parents.append(ParentRequirement(requirement_id=rid, text=clean, importance=importance, source_span=span, atom_ids=[aid]))
        atoms.append(RequirementAtom(atom_id=aid, parent_requirement_id=rid, text=clean, source_span=span))
        wanted = terms(clean)
        matches = []
        for sid, (path, fact) in store.origins.items():
            overlap = wanted & terms(fact.text)
            if overlap:
                matches.append((len(overlap), sid, fact))
        matches.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
        links = []
        for _, sid, fact in matches[:5]:
            negative = bool(re.search(r'不熟悉|未使用|没有使用|未进行|未独立|不具备|不掌握|无.{0,6}经验|\b(?:not|never|no experience)\b', fact.text, re.I))
            link_span = store.make_span(store.catalog, sid, 0, len(fact.text))
            links.append(EvidenceLink(link_id=f'{aid}-link-{len(links)}', atom_id=aid, source_span=link_span,
                                      claim=fact.text, support_status='contradictory' if negative else 'partial',
                                      level='C1', confidence=0.0, needs_confirmation=True,
                                      independence_group=store.independence_group(link_span)))
        results.append(AtomEvidenceResult(atom_id=aid, links=links,
            match_status=EvidenceMappingService._match_status(links), has_contradiction=any(l.support_status=='contradictory' for l in links),
            rationale='仅按已知术语查找原文，未判断语义支持；带否定/范围限定的材料需核对。' if links else
                      '当前所选版本未找到可自动定位的术语线索；可能是表述不同或材料缺失，不能推断你没有该能力。'))
    if not atoms:
        raise MatchError('jd_has_no_requirements')
    return (RequirementAnalysis(parents=parents, atoms=atoms, warnings=['local_clause_precheck_not_semantic_atoms','maximum_24_clauses']),
            EvidenceMappingV2(atom_results=results))

class WorkbenchMatcher:
    def __init__(self, provider=None):
        self.provider = provider

    def analyze(self, match_id: str, version: VersionRecord, request: AnalyzeRequest) -> MatchPayload:
        store = VersionSourceStore(version, request.jd_text)
        if len(store.facts) > 300 or sum(map(len,store.texts.values())) > 30_000:
            raise MatchError('match_input_too_large')
        usage = ParseUsage()
        started = perf_counter()
        if request.mode == 'local_check':
            requirements, mapping = local_precheck(store)
            provider, model = 'python', 'local-clause-term-precheck-v1'
        else:
            if self.provider is None:
                raise MatchError('match_model_unavailable')
            if not request.allow_external_processing:
                raise MatchError('external_processing_consent_required')
            bounded = BoundedProvider(self.provider)
            harness = LLMHarness(bounded)
            requirements = RequirementAnalyzer(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).analyze(
                store.catalog.documents[0],catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            mapping = EvidenceMappingService(registry=_Registry(),harness=harness,source_store=store).map(
                requirements,catalog=store.catalog,session_id=match_id,run_id=match_id)
            usage.provider_calls = bounded.calls
            for key in ('input_tokens','output_tokens'):
                values = [getattr(t,key) for t in harness.traces]
                setattr(usage,key,sum(values) if values and all(v is not None for v in values) else None)
            provider, model = str(bounded.provider_name), str(bounded.model)
        config = initial_fit_policy_v2()
        bundle = EvidenceBundle(manifest=EvidenceRunManifest(run_id=match_id,created_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            jd_parser_version='workbench-m3-existing-evidence-v2' if request.mode=='llm' else 'local-clauses-v1',
            evidence_prompt_version='workbench-m3-C1-only', fit_policy_version=config.version,
            provider=provider,model=model,source_fingerprint=digest(''.join(d.content_hash for d in store.catalog.documents))),
            sources=store.catalog,requirements=requirements,mapping=mapping,
            assessment=FitAssessmentPolicy().assess(requirements,mapping,config=config))
        validate_bundle(store,bundle)
        usage.latency_ms = max(0,int((perf_counter()-started)*1000))
        return MatchPayload(match_id=match_id,resume_id=version.resume_id,version_id=version.version_id,
            version_hash=version.content_hash,title=request.title,jd_text=request.jd_text,mode=request.mode,bundle=bundle,
            proposals=propose_order(version,store,bundle),usage=usage,created_at=datetime.now(UTC))

                pdf_hash TEXT NOT NULL, pdf_bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(version_id, template, renderer))''')

    def export(self, owner, resume_id, version_id, request: PDFRequest):
        version = self.workspace.get_version(owner, resume_id, version_id)
        if version.content_hash != request.expected_content_hash:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_version_changed')
        if not version.confirmed_at:
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_confirmation_required')
        export_id = 'pdf-' + sha256(f'{version_id}:{request.template}:{RENDERER_VERSION}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            existing = db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_pdf_exports WHERE export_id=?', (export_id,)).fetchone()
        if existing is None:
            data = render_pdf(version, request.template)
            with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
                self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
                self.workspace._version(db, resume_id, version_id)
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rw_pdf_exports VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                           (export_id, version_id, request.template, RENDERER_VERSION,
                            version.content_hash, sha256(data).hexdigest(), data))
        return self.metadata(owner, export_id)

    def _get(self, db, owner, export_id):
        row = db.execute('''SELECT e.*,v.resume_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
            JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id JOIN rw_resumes r ON r.resume_id=v.resume_id
            WHERE e.export_id=? AND r.owner_id=?''', (export_id, owner)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise WorkspaceNotFound('pdf_not_found')
        version = self.workspace._version(db, row['resume_id'], row['version_id'])
        self.workspace._validate_document(db, owner, version.document)

                or sha256(row['pdf_bytes']).hexdigest() != row['pdf_hash']):
            raise WorkspaceConflict('pdf_integrity_failed')
        return row

        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            row = self._get(db, owner, export_id)
            return {k:row[k] for k in ('export_id','resume_id','version_id','template','renderer','content_hash','pdf_hash')}

    def download(self, owner, export_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            return bytes(self._get(db, owner, export_id)['pdf_bytes'])

    def list(self, owner, resume_id):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            self.workspace._resume(db, owner, resume_id)
            ids = [r[0] for r in db.execute('''SELECT e.export_id FROM rw_pdf_exports e
                JOIN rw_versions v ON e.version_id=v.version_id WHERE v.resume_id=?
                ORDER BY v.sequence DESC,e.template''', (resume_id,))]
        return [self.metadata(owner, key) for key in ids]
